clips.title: The story
paras: At a ruined farmstead south of Darkshire, the Spectral Comb gathers ghost hair from Blind Mary.

Ghostly hair lies beyond the reach of ordinary combs, leaving mortal craftsmen few ways to gather such fibers. The Spectral Comb can pass through a spirit’s intangible tresses. Carried south of Darkshire to a ruined farmstead, it is offered to Blind Mary, a weeping ghost who wails alone. Grooming brings her solace, and she willingly uses the comb. The spectral fibers she leaves behind can be woven into Ghost Hair Thread.
